data.title: Fantasy Player News
data.description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (groin) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Breece Hall (groin) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Hall is pretty well over his groin injury at this point and was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday. He should be healthy for the foreseeable future and projects to be a high-quality fantasy asset for as long as he can remain on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam LaPorta (hip) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Sam LaPorta (hip) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: LaPorta is now off of the injury report after dealing with a hip injury for the latter part of the preseason. He should be a full go for Week 1 and will remain a startable fantasy option in this matchup and beyond.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) good to go for Week 1
items.desc: Luther Burden III (groin) is off of the injury report and good to go for Week 1's matchup against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Burden was dealing with a groin injury earlier in the offseason, but he is fully healthy now and carries no injury designation ahead of Sunday's season opener. He should play without any restrictions and will be primed for a huge Week 1 if the Bears are without Rome Odunze (calf) for their matchup against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyson Bagent (back) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyson Bagent (back) missed Chicago's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Bears may be without their backup quarterback in Week 1, as Bagent was unable to practice due to a back injury that he's dealing with. Case Keenum would be the next man up as the backup to Caleb Williams if the 26-year old is inactive against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rome Odunze (calf) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rome Odunze (calf) was limited at Chicago's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Odunze is considered day-to-day due to a calf injury that he's dealing with. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, and it looks like his availability for Week 1 remains up in the air at this point. Look for Luther Burden III and Colston Loveland to see a lot of work if he's ruled out for the season opener, with Zavion Thomas likely to see more work as well.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was limited at Atlanta's practice on Wednesday due to a minor hamstring injury that he's dealing with. It remains to be seen whether or not it will affect his availability for Week 1, but either way he isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Penix has already been ruled out for Week 1 as he continues to recover from a knee injury of some kind. He was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, however, which indicates that he is nearly healthy enough to make his return to the field. Either way, it looks like Tua Tagovailoa will remain Atlanta's starting quarterback for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) to miss 'a game or two'
items.desc: Brock Bowers underwent a minor meniscus trim operation on Tuesday and is set to be sidelined for 'a game or two' as a result.
items.impact: Bowers reportedly got 'banged up' during training camp last week, and the team made the decision to have him undergo a minor procedure to trim his meniscus. This is especially concerning considering that he missed much of last year due to a nagging knee injury, and the team already expects him to be sidelined for at least a game or two while he recovers from this one. This is an alarming situation that fantasy managers should keep close tabs on, as this injury could linger if there are any setbacks in his recovery. Michael Mayer will step in as the team's top tight end in his absence, with Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor both also likely to see an increase in opportunities in the star tight end's absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) logs full practice Wednesday, likely to play Sunday
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) logged a full practice on Wednesday night and is trending towards playing in Sunday night's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: HC John Harbaugh told reporters that he thinks Nabers will be ready to go for the team's season opener against the Cowboys on Sunday night. This comes after he logged a full practice session on Wednesday, so he seems to be trending towards being close to full health for Week 1. If there are no setbacks throughout the week, fantasy managers should start him with confidence in what projects to be a high scoring matchup against their divisional rivals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Khalil Shakir (undisclosed) seen practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Khalil Shakir (undisclosed) was seen practicing for the Bills on Wednesday.
items.impact: Shakir's availability for Week 1 is currently up in the air due to an undisclosed injury that he's dealing with. He was spotted at practice on Wednesday, however, which bodes well for his availability for the season opener. It remains unclear if he was a limited or full participant.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) off injury report for Week 1
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 1's matchup against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Hubbard was battling a hamstring injury earlier this offseason, but it's no longer an issue for him and he carries no injury designation ahead of Week 1. He will likely split work with Jonathan Brooks (groin) in the season opener, which hurts the fantasy outlook for both of them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (groin) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks (groin) was officially limited in Wednesday's practice for the Panthers.
items.impact: The team has been calling Brooks' injury 'general soreness' for a little while, but it seems that it is specifically groin soreness, which left him limited at Wednesday's practice. He seems to be trending towards playing in Week 1 but may not be worth starting in fantasy if he's playing at less than full health against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (leg) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Johnson (leg) is not practicing for the Bills on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran is not taking part in Wednesday's practice due to a leg injury that he suffered a while ago. It remains to be seen when he will be healthy enough to return to the field, but either way his absence doesn't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carson Wentz to serve as backup quarterback Week 1
items.desc: Carson Wentz will serve as Minnesota's backup quarterback in Week 1 against the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Wentz beat out J.J. McCarthy for the backup quarterback job behind Kyler Murray for the team's season opener on Sunday. He found some success in his limited action as a backup last year, so him being next in line adds another layer of security for fantasy assets like Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: J.J. McCarthy to be QB3 for Week 1
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy will be the third quarterback on Minnesota's depth chart for their season opener against the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
items.impact: McCarthy lost the competition for the starting QB job earlier this offseason to Kyler Murray, and now it appears that he didn't make a strong push for the job, as the team has opted to make him the third QB on their depth chart behind Carson Wentz as well. The team has left the door open to promoting him to backup at some point in the season, but he remains entirely irrelevant for fantasy purposes for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rachaad White (hamstring) set to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rachaad White (hamstring) is set to take part in Washington's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: White's status for Week 1 is still unclear right now thanks to a hamstring injury that he's still dealing with. He is taking part in Wednesday's practice, however, which is a step in the right direction for him. Fantasy managers should pay attention to updates about his health throughout the week, as Jacory Croskey-Merritt will be a significantly better fantasy option if the veteran is sidelined this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hand) says he will play Sunday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hand) told reporters that he is going to play in Sunday's season opener against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Meyers was practicing in a non-contact jersey on Wednesday due to his hand injury, but it seems that was only a precautionary measure, and he told reporters that he is going to play in the team's season opener on Sunday. His presence will mean more competition for Parker Washington, Brian Thomas Jr., and Travis Hunter against the Browns.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) set to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) is set to take part in Las Vegas' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jeanty will participate in the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. It is unknown if he will be a limited or full participant, but we should get clarity on that later in the day. His injury status has a lot of implications ahead of Week 1, so it should be monitored closely throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tee Higgins (heel) on pace to play Sunday
items.desc: Tee Higgins (heel) is on pace to play in Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Higgins is reportedly on pace to play in the team's season opener on Sunday, despite still managing a heel injury that has been bothering him for multiple weeks. His availability for the season opener would render both him and QB Joe Burrow great fantasy options heading into Week 1.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) on track to play Sunday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) is on track to play in Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Chase has been recovering from a minor knee injury for several weeks at this point, but it is not considered a serious issue and he is on track to play through it against the Buccaneers on Sunday. Assuming he's active for the season opener, fantasy managers should have no hesitations about starting him and viewing him as a top-tier fantasy asset moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) will start Sunday, set to have no snap count
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) will be a starter and have no snap count in Miami's season opener against the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday.
items.impact: The rookie fell in the NFL Draft this year due to a major knee injury that he was rehabbing, but it looks like he is 100% healthy heading into the team's season opener, as they confirmed that he will start and will not have a snap count in Week 1. He will start alongside fellow rookie Caleb Douglas, and it looks likely that one or both of them will become fantasy relevant this year with how thin Miami's WR depth chart is heading into Week 1.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas set to start in Week 1
items.desc: Caleb Douglas is set to be a starter for the Dolphins in their Week 1 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: The Dolphins selected Douglas in the third round of this year's draft, but he had an impressive offseason for them and is set to be a starter for the team in their season opener. That's a great sign for his season outlook, as it means he will have ample opportunities to prove himself and break out from the very start of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Shedeur Sanders expected to be QB2 in Week 1
items.desc: Shedeur Sanders is expected to be active as Cleveland's backup quarterback in Week 1.
items.impact: Deshaun Watson won the starting QB job for the Browns, and now the team has confirmed the Sanders is going to be active on gamedays and serve as their backup quarterback in Week 1. He won't seen the field in any large capacity for the foreseeable future, barring any injury to Watson.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sean Tucker not seen at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Sean Tucker (undisclosed) was not spotted at Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tucker has missed time with an undisclosed injury recently. He was not spotted at Wednesday's practice as well, which is not a good sign for his availability ahead of Week 1. If he's ruled out, Kenny Gainwell will be primed for more work in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) participating at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) is participating at Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McMillan is taking part in Tampa Bay's first official practice of the week on Wednesday. He was sidelined for part of the offseason due to a knee injury, but he seems to be nearly full health at this point and looks likely to play in Week 1. We should learn more when the team's official injury report comes out after practice.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) seen practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (toe) was seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Wednesday.
items.impact: Egbuka has been dealing with a nagging toe injury for several weeks, but he was seen practicing with the Buccaneers on Wednesday ahead of their season opener against the Bengals on Sunday. That's a good sign for his health heading into Week 1, but fantasy managers should keep tabs on further updates about his health in the coming days to see whether or not he will be fully healthy for the first game of the season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (soft tissue) to be game-time decision
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. is expected to be a game-time decision for Week 1.
items.impact: Allen missed the last couple of weeks of camp due to a soft-tissue injury in his lower body. Head coach Liam Coen has suggested that the second-year running back's participation level in practice this week will go a long way towards determining his availability for Sunday. Allen is expected to contribute mostly on third-down situations and possibly special teams this season. Ameer Abdullah would likely see some opportunities if Allen cannot go.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jihad Ward joins Vikings' practice squad
items.desc: Jihad Ward signed a contract to join the Vikings' practice squad.
items.impact: Ward, who spent the 2024 season with the Vikings, rejoins his former team to provide more veteran depth on defense. Ward played in all 17 games with the Titans last season, recording 31 total tackles and five sacks.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee) ready to go for Week 1
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee) has been practicing and will play in the 49ers' season opener on Thursday.
items.impact: Bosa is coming off what was largely a lost season that was ended early by a torn ACL. The five-time Pro Bowler has been working his way back this preseason and says he's "100 percent ready to go" for Week 1. The 49ers take on the division-rival Rams on Thursday in Australia.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alfred Collins out for season with torn patellar tendon
items.desc: 49ers DT Alfred Collins tore patellar tendon in practice and is out for the season.
items.impact: It is another brutal injury for the 49ers, even while they're in Australia. The depth on the defensive line takes a hit for San Francisco just two days before the start of the season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jeremiyah Love: status improving for Week 1
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love is improving as the Cardinals approach Week 1. When asked about Love's status for the season opener, HC Mike LaFleur said "I feel good."
items.impact: Love has been struggling with a high ankle sprain injury for a few weeks now, but this is a promising sign for his return. The first round rookie should be in line for a nice workload, and he flashed serious ability in his limited preseason action.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Puka Nacua not listed on Rams first injury report
items.desc: Puka Nacua is not listed on the Rams initial injury report for Week 1.
items.impact: Puka has been dealing with a psoas injury for a little over a week, but his absence on the injury report is a big indication that barring a setback, he will play on Thursday. The star receiver should be a full go and lock into fantasy lineups.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) limited in practice Tuesday
items.desc: George Kittle was limited in Tuesday's practice.
items.impact: Kittle remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's season opener coming off an Achilles tear. It is unclear if he'll be facing any sort of snap count on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) expected to play Thursday
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said Myles Garrett will be ready to go for Week 1's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Garrett did not participate in Tuesday's practice. He is still expected to be good to go for his Rams debut on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emanuel Wilson (hamstring) off injury report Wednesday
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Wilson practiced in full all week. He'll be in a depth role in the Seahawks backfield going into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Julian Neal (quad) off injury report Wednesday
items.desc: Julian Neal is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Neal is good to go heading into his debut on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee) off injury report Wednesday
items.desc: Anthony Bradford is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Bradford is fully good to go for Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner (oblique) off injury report Wednesday
items.desc: AJ Barner is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Barner practiced all week in full. He'll be a TE2 for fantasy managers going into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jones (knee) off injury report Wednesday
items.desc: Josh Jones is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Jones will be good to go in his depth role on the offensive line for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton (hamstring) listed questionable Wednesday
items.desc: Tory Horton is listed as questionable for Wednesday's season opener against the Patriots.
items.impact: Horton was limited in practice the past few days. His status is up in the air heading into Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) listed questionable Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Emmanwori was limited in practice the past few days. His status is up in the air heading into Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Okada (hamstring) ruled out Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Okada has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Okada was unable to practice the past few days. The Seahawks will be short-handed at safety.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield signs three-year extension with Bucs
items.desc: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers reached agreement today on a three-year contract extension.
items.impact: This move comes out of no where as reports suggested talks between the two sides on an extension weren't going to continue this season. Mayfield lands his extension right before the start of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Barmore (knee) off injury report Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Barmore is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Barmore returned to a full practice on Monday. He will be good to go for Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) ruled out for Week 1
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 1 for the New England Patriots against the Seattle Seahawks according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Henderson will miss the season opener after being unable to practice to begin the week for head coach Mike Vrabel. Rhamondre Stevenson will see as many touches as he can handle against a strong Seattle front seven Wednesday night.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Aaron Donald ruled out for Week 1
items.desc: Aaron Donald has been ruled out for Week 1 for the Los Angeles Rams against the San Francisco 49ers according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Donald will not travel with the team for their Thursday night matchup against San Francisco in Australia as the superstar defensive tackle works back from two years in retirement.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mason Rudolph listed as Steelers' QB2 on Week 1 depth chart
items.desc: The Steelers have listed Mason Rudolph as their QB2 on the Week 1 depth chart.
items.impact: Will Howard is No. 3 and rookie Drew Allar is No. 4 on the opening depth chart as the Steelers kept all four quarterbacks on the roster.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) not expected to play Week 1
items.desc: Josh Simmons is not expected to play in the Chiefs season opener against the Broncos.
items.impact: Simmons has been sidelined with a back injury. Chiefs coach Andy Reid said rookie UDFA Kahlil Benson would likely start at left tackle in Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kahlil Benson to likely start at left tackle Week 1 for Chiefs
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said rookie UDFA Kahlil Benson would likely start at left tackle in Week 1.
items.impact: Benson is likely to start in place of the injured Josh Simmons. It is not exactly ideal in Patrick Mahomes first start back off his torn ACL.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Tyler Allgeier listed as starter on Cardinals depth chart
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier was listed as the starting running back on the Cardinals' Week 1 depth chart.
items.impact: Allgeier was listed as the starter ahead of rookie Jeremiyah Love after a training camp battle. Love has also been making his way back from an ankle sprain, which could be why Allgeier sees more carries in the early part of the season. If he does indeed get the start on Sunday, Allgeier could be an RB3 or deeper flex option in fantasy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Braxton Jones named Bears starting left tackle
items.desc: Braxton Jones has officially been named the Bears starting left tackle.
items.impact: Jones re-signed with Chicago on a one-year contract back in March. He was competing for the left tackle job in camp with Jedrick Wills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Gordon (calf) away from Bears working with trainer
items.desc: Bears CB Kyler Gordon is away from the team working with his own trainer to accelerate recovery.
items.impact: Gordon is expected to return a few weeks into the season and begin practicing shortly thereafter. He is on injured reserve to open the season with a calf injury.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Brandon Graham announces retirement
items.desc: Brandon Graham announced his retirement from the NFL on Tuesday.
items.impact: Graham will hang up his cleats after spending 16 seasons with the Eagles. The defensive end earned one Pro Bowl honor and won a pair of Super Bowls with the Eagles in his career, missing just one game from 2012 to 2020.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Zay Flowers (lower body) practices Tuesday
items.desc: Zay Flowers is practicing for the Ravens on Tuesday after dealing with a lower-body injury.
items.impact: Flowers had missed two full weeks of practice with a lower-body injury before returning last Thursday. The wideout being on the field on Tuesday is a good sign for him playing in Week 1, but fantasy managers should keep an eye on him leading up to Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devontez Walker not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Ravens WR Devontez Walker is not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what injury Walker is dealing with. He was running on the side field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) to start Week 1 barring setback
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Patrick Mahomes is set to start on Monday night barring a setback.
items.impact: Mahomes has officially worked his way back from a torn ACL and LCL suffered in Week 15 last year. He has said he may not run as much coming off the injury, at least early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joseph Ossai (foot) week-to-week
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Joseph Ossai is week-to-week.
items.impact: Ossai is not expected to play in the season opener on Sunday.

items.impact: Lafayette will seek another opportunity heading into the season.

items.impact: Gray got into a UTV accident over the weekend.

items.desc: Odafe Oweh took part in Washington's walk through on Monday.
items.impact: It is a positive sign to start the week for Oweh.

items.impact: Kacmarek previously missed time during camp.

items.impact: Kareem will enter the season in a depth role on the defensive line for San Francisco.

items.desc: The Bears have released veteran WR Ray-Ray McCloud with an injury settlement.
items.impact: McCloud will seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.title: Bralen Trice signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed EDGE defender Bralen Trice to their practice squad.
items.impact: Trice was previously waived by Atlanta. He'll get another opportunity on the practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Oladokun waived by Chiefs
items.desc: The Chiefs waived QB Chris Oladokun.
